::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 12th 1867  
**From:** Puslinch Yealmpton  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)
If it is copyright, I think they ought to give you at least £10, you did not sell your copyright to the [Eagle](other_books/otherbook_365.qmd) and it may sometimes make a difference in case of one’s wanting to collect short stories together into a volume[^1] 

I do not know if this is the right sum, but it seems to me about fair

yours affectionately and much hurried
C M Yonge

I shall be here till the 30th so the answer had better come here.

---

[^1]: Probably the question was how much [Warne](organizations/other_1422.qmd) should pay Coleridge for the copyright of *Giftie*, in comparison with whatever had been paid by CMY for the publication of ‘The Eagle of one house is the Goose of another’ in *MP*.
